none: PAS FindID 931615: Roman silver finger ring fragment
contea di ritrovamento: West Berkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Description: A fragment of a Roman silver finger ring. The fragment is L-shaped, bent at a slight angle and oval in cross-section. The fragment is possibly the remainder of the shoulder joining the bezel of the ring. It is sub-rectangular in shape and has incised lines for decoration on the surface.
